card.name: First names of climate scientists
card.fires_on: A person's first name (or an author's name in a citation) right before the surname, in news or reference text about climate, ecology, oceans or environment. The named person is usually a scientist or advocate quoted on those topics.

modes.label: Quoted expert
modes.description: First name of a scientist or official introduced after 'said' or 'says' in an environmental news story.

modes.label: Titled researcher
modes.description: First name after a job title such as President or Professor, before the surname.
modes.example: Scripps Professor<< Jeremy>> Jackson as "the rise of slime."

modes.label: Citation author
modes.description: Author names in reference lists of environmental papers.

card.writes: It pushes toward climate and ecology words such as Climate, atmospheric, eco, which fit the likely subject of the person's work.
card.plain: It spots the first name of a person quoted or cited in climate and environment writing.
